item.title: Underemployment, Triple Shooting, Royal Visit Roadworks
item.ns0:title: Underemployment, Triple Shooting, Royal Visit Roadworks
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, new national statistics reveal a troubling rise in underemployment across The Bahamas even as overall unemployment continues to decline. Police launch an active investigation into a violent overnight triple shooting in Wilson Track that left one man dead and two others hospitalized. Works Minister Clay Sweeding pushes back against speculation that extensive downtown road paving projects are being carried out specifically for King Charles’s upcoming visit. Plus, union leadership battles heat up following controversial BPSU election results, emergency runway repairs kick off at North Eleuthera Airport, and we bring you the latest in local sports and weather!
